events.operator: Uttar Pradesh Rajya Vidyut Utpadan Nigam (state generator); UPPCL distribution
events.summary: A 72-hour strike by Uttar Pradesh power-sector employees from about 22:00 on 16 Mar 2023 shut some thermal generating units and disrupted distribution; official sources said rural outages were about double the urban figure. The strike was called off on 19 Mar 2023 after talks with the state energy minister.
events.effect: IANS: ~2,392 MW of generation unavailable by the evening of 18 Mar (~17% of 13,856 MW demand); urban and semi-urban feeders shut affected ~13 lakh households, rural outages said to be about double. The power minister said there was no shortage.
events.threshold_basis: Clause 4 (power-plant units >=500 MW aggregate forced offline with reported supply effect) and clause 5 (~1.3 million households on urban feeders alone).

capacity_affected.source_says: 2,392 MW power generation, which is 17 per cent of the total 13,856 MW demand, was not available (IANS).

recovery.evidence: Strike called off ~15:00 on 19 Mar 2023 (FPJ). No source reviewed states when the shut units resynchronised or when supply normalised; the end of the cause is not recorded as restoration.

events.facility_name: Sikka port; Vadinar port; Mundra and Kandla ports
events.operator: Reliance Industries (Sikka); Nayara Energy (Vadinar); Adani Ports (Mundra); Deendayal Port Authority (Kandla)
events.summary: Ahead of Cyclone Biparjoy's landfall in Gujarat (15-16 Jun 2023), Gujarat ports suspended operations, including oil product exports and vessel operations at several ports. Nayara Energy said it was not closing operations at Vadinar port but directed vessels not to enter port limits.
events.effect: Product exports from Sikka halted (Reuters); Adani suspended vessel operations at Mundra and Tuna (Reuters); Gujarat Maritime Board listed Vadinar, Mundra and Kandla as suspended (Bloomberg), while Reuters reported Nayara not closing Vadinar but barring vessel entry. No refinery shutdown reported.
events.threshold_basis: Clause 2: energy import/export terminals suspended operations (precautionary, weather-driven). No refinery throughput effect reported, so clause 1 is NOT claimed.

recovery.evidence: Reliance had resumed vessel operations at Sikka by 19 Jun 2023, the report date (Reuters via ThePrint); Kandla and Pipavav said they resumed on the preceding Saturday. Vadinar/Mundra resumption dates not separately confirmed.

events.summary: A fire at a Power Grid Corporation of India substation in Uttar Pradesh on the afternoon of 11 Jun 2024 caused outages in Delhi during a heatwave. The asset is in Uttar Pradesh; the supply effect fell in Delhi (IN-DL).
events.effect: TPDDL reported 440 MW load shedding affecting ~4 lakh consumers. Outage of about 1-2 hours.

capacity_affected.source_says: TPDDL reported load shedding of 440 MW, affecting about 4 lakh consumers

recovery.evidence: Discom official: supply resumed within an hour; TPDDL said restoration completed within an hour; Delhi minister cited ~2 hours. Physical repair of the substation not reported.

events.summary: Severe cyclonic storm Montha crossed the Andhra Pradesh coast on the night of 28-29 October 2025, damaging distribution poles and lines across the coastal districts.
events.effect: The eastern distribution company (APEPDCL) reported about 1.3 million service connections affected.
events.threshold_basis: Grid outages affecting far more than 100,000 customers.

recovery.evidence: APEPDCL's managing director said on 29 October that all household connections would be restored that night and agricultural connections by the next day: an expectation, not an observed restoration.

events.summary: A fire on 29 May 2023 at the Numaligarh refinery in Assam, while the plant was restarting after maintenance. The petroleum ministry's monthly report attributes the refinery's lower crude processing in June and July 2023 to the fire.
events.effect: Crude processed in June 2023 was 8.30 thousand tonnes against a target of 267.00 and 240.56 in June 2022 (ministry monthly report).
events.threshold_basis: Clause 1: refinery throughput materially cut with the effect reported: 8.30 TMT processed in June 2023 against a 267.00 TMT monthly target, attributed by the ministry to the fire.

events.summary: On 16 August 2025 GAIL reported a gas leak on its Gauna-Bawana pipeline after heavy rain and a shift in a river's course; the affected section was isolated and gas supply through it stopped.
